prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1377; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The mechanism described is consistent with the wrist injury diagnosed on imaging, which showed a distal radius fracture. Over the course of seven visits, the patient received immobilization, orthopedic follow-up, and a graded home exercise program. Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as range of motion and grip strength improved. Physical examination revealed localized tenderness and swelling over the distal radius and reduced grip strength on the injured side, supporting the fracture diagnosis, while neurovascular testing and sensation remained within normal limits. The patient reports a remote, minor strain to the same wrist region in the past, which resolved completely without lasting limitation and does not appear to have affected the current presentation. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service with no duplicate or repeated entries.
